title: Wario Land: Super Mario Land 3
shortDescription: Wario Land: Super Mario Land 3 helps define a Game Boy family platformer path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced platformer option to the Game Boy family discovery path.
Keeps the external item link distinct from the deterministic catalog method.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Mapped for the Game Boy family platformer discovery path using Wikidata-listed platform and genre statements; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
